items.name: portless
items.title: Portless dev URLs
items.description: Named local HTTPS URLs for the api, spa, ssr and static apps, with a .local LAN mode for phones. Starting the proxy needs sudo (it binds 443 and trusts a local CA). Root scripts: dev:portless = bun scripts/dev-portless.ts, dev:lan:portless = bun scripts/dev-portless.ts --lan.
